lines.text: Look, it's simple: I love a story involving a lighthouse, especially one that explores dark places where the boundaries of reality begin to blur. Diego Muzzio's English-language debut is a gothic triumph. For me, it has all the makings of a new classic. Adrienne's Reviews Staff Reviews
